name: Annual Performance Review-custom_employee_comments
label: Employee Comments
description: Your own comments on the year and on your KRA achievements. Only you can edit this.

name: Budget-custom_budget_title
label: Budget Title
description: Auto-generated display label (Account name + Cost Center) shown wherever this Budget is picked as a Link, instead of the raw Budget ID.

name: Employee-custom_coi_status
label: COI Status
options:
Not Sent
Sent
Sending Failed
Received

name: Employee Exit-custom_exit_reason
label: Exit Reason (Selected by Manager)
description: Chosen by the line manager from the approved list.

name: Employee Exit-custom_signed_resignation
label: Signed Resignation Letter
description: Upload the signed resignation letter (PDF or image).

name: Employee Exit-custom_notice_period_days
label: Notice Period (Days)
read_only_depends_on: eval:!(frappe.user.has_role('HR Manager') || frappe.user.has_role('HR User') || frappe.user.has_role('System Manager'))
description: Taken from the employee record. HR can change it if the notice period is reduced or extended; the Last Working Day then updates.

name: Employee Exit-custom_signed_acknowledgement
label: System-Signed Acknowledgement (PDF)
description: Generated automatically when the resignation is submitted and at each approval.

name: Employment Type-custom_type_code
label: ID Code
description: Two-letter code used in Job Opening, Applicant and Employee IDs (for example FT).

name: HR Settings-custom_allow_budget_overconsumption
label: Allow Budget/Headcount Overconsumption on Job Requisition
description: When checked, Job Requisitions can be Final-Approved even if they exceed the Workforce Plan's remaining budget or headcount — the excess is recorded as variance instead of being blocked. Uncheck to hard-block over-budget approvals again.

name: HR Settings-custom_official_email_domain_keyword
label: Official Email Domain Must Contain
description: An employee can only be made Active when their Official Email domain contains this text, e.g. vodafone.qa, vodafone.com, vodafone.in.

name: Job Applicant-custom_gender
label: Gender
options:
Male
Female
Prefer not to say

name: Job Applicant-custom_role_code
label: Position Code
description: Carried from the Workforce Plan Position role code, through the Job Requisition and Job Opening.

name: Job Applicant-custom_hiring_manager
label: Hiring Manager
description: Taken from the Job Requisition role.

name: Job Applicant-custom_ageing_days
label: Ageing (Days)
description: Days from Role sharing date to Onboarded date (or today if not yet onboarded).

name: Job Applicant-custom_current_company
label: Current Company
description: Candidate's present employer.

name: Job Applicant-custom_current_notice_period
label: Current Notice Period
options:
Immediate
15 Days
30 Days
45 Days
60 Days
90 Days
More than 90 Days

name: Job Applicant-custom_joining_date
label: Tentative Date of Joining
description: Mandatory from Shortlisted onwards. Also becomes the Employee Date of Joining on onboarding.

name: Job Applicant-custom_joining_month
label: Month
description: Month of the Tentative Date of Joining.

name: Job Applicant-custom_expected_salary
label: Expected CTC (Yearly, USD)
description: Yearly expected CTC, including Basic, Allowance and Benefits.

name: Job Applicant-custom_expected_ctc_section
label: CTC Breakdown (USD)
description: Basic + Allowance = Gross. Gross + Benefits = CTC, which must equal the Agreed Salary before the applicant can move to Approved to onboard.

name: Job Applicant-custom_ctc_allowance
label: Allowance (Yearly)
description: Enter 0 if not applicable.

name: Job Applicant-custom_ctc_benefits
label: Benefits (Yearly)
description: Enter 0 if not applicable.

name: Job Applicant-custom_interview_schedule_confirmed_date
label: Interview Schedule Confirmed Date
description: Logged when the applicant moves to Interview Scheduled.

name: Job Applicant-custom_shortlisting_confirmation_date
label: Shortlisting Confirmation Date
description: Logged when the applicant moves to Shortlisted.

name: Job Applicant-custom_onboarded_date
label: Onboarded Date
description: Logged when the applicant moves to Onboarded.

name: Job Applicant-custom_onboarded
label: Onboarded
description: Ticked automatically when the applicant moves to Onboarded.

name: Job Applicant-custom_budget_consumed
label: Budget Consumed
description: Set automatically once this applicant's hire has been consumed against the Recruitment Budget Plan / Job Requisition, to prevent double counting.

name: Job Opening-custom_confidential_hiring
label: Confidential Hiring
description: Set from the Job Requisition. Confidential openings cannot be pushed to a vendor.

name: Job Opening-custom_pushed_to_vendor
label: Pushed to Vendor
description: Tick to push this opening to the vendor. Requires the linked Job Requisition to be finally approved, and a Vendor to be set.

name: Job Opening-custom_vendor_push_date
label: Role sharing date
description: Date the role was shared with the vendor. Required once the opening is saved.

name: Job Opening-custom_vendor_ageing_days
label: Ageing With Vendor (Days)
description: Days since this opening was pushed to the vendor. Recalculated whenever the record is saved.

name: Job Opening-custom_vendor_sla_days
label: Vendor SLA (Days)
description: The linked Vendor's committed fill SLA, in days.

name: Job Opening-custom_closing_sla_days
label: Closing SLA (Days)
description: Days remaining until Closes On. Negative once past the closing date. Recalculated on every save.

name: Job Opening-custom_sla_breached
label: SLA Breached
description: Set automatically when Ageing With Vendor (Days) exceeds the Vendor SLA (Days).

name: Job Opening-custom_vendor_history
label: Vendor History
description: Logged automatically whenever the Vendor field is changed. Visible to internal teams only.

name: Job Requisition-custom_requisition_title
label: Requisition Title
description: Auto-generated summary of the roles on this requisition. Shown in the list view; the document ID (naming series) remains the unique identifier.

name: Job Requisition-custom_currency_code_usd
label: Currency Code (USD)
description: Internal helper so USD Currency fields always display the $ symbol regardless of company default currency.

name: Job Requisition-custom_currency_code_qar
label: Currency Code (QAR)
description: Internal helper so QAR Currency fields always display the ر.ق symbol regardless of company default currency.

name: Job Requisition-custom_confidential_hiring
label: Confidential Hiring
description: Confidential positions stay internal: no vendor push.

name: Job Requisition-custom_roles
label: Roles
description: Add one row per role/position being requisitioned. Total positions and costs below roll up from this table.

name: Job Requisition-custom_monthly_budget_per_headcount
label: Monthly Budget Per Headcount (USD) $
description: Taken from the Workforce Plan.

name: Job Requisition-custom_budget_variance_usd
label: Budget Variance (USD)
description: Amount by which this requisition's annual budget impact exceeds the Workforce Plan's remaining budget. 0 means no overconsumption.

name: Job Requisition-custom_headcount_variance
label: Headcount Variance
description: Number of positions requested beyond the Workforce Plan's remaining headcount. 0 means no overconsumption.

name: Job Requisition-custom_budget_consumed
label: Budget Consumed
description: Set automatically once this requisition's approval has been consumed against the Recruitment Budget Plan, to prevent double counting.

name: Supplier-custom_probation_period_months
label: Probation Period (Months)
description: Standard probation period (in months) applied to employees sourced through this vendor.

name: Supplier-custom_notice_period_days
label: Notice Period (Days)
description: Default notice period (in days) for candidates sourced through this vendor. Auto-fetched onto the Employee record (Notice (days)) when this vendor is linked.

name: Supplier-custom_sla_days
label: Vendor Fill SLA (Days)
description: Contractual number of days this vendor commits to fill an open position once it is pushed to them.

name: Supplier-custom_holiday_list
label: Holiday List (for this vendor's employees)
description: New employees from this vendor get this holiday list. If empty, the Qatar list is used.

name: Workforce Plan-custom_approval_summary_section
label: Approval Summary
depends_on: eval:frappe.user_roles.some(function(r){return ['Functional Head','Head of OD & Total Rewards','CAO','CEO / Final Approver','HR Manager','System Manager'].indexOf(r)>-1;})

name: Workforce Plan-custom_budget_line_not_confirmed
label: Budget Line Not Confirmed
description: Tick this if you don't know the exact Budget Line yet.

name: Workforce Plan-custom_best_known_budget_line
label: Best Known Budget Line (Reference Only)
description: Free-text note only. Does not change the actual Budget Line or Cost Center links.

name: Workforce Plan-custom_confidential_hiring
label: Confidential Hiring
description: Only HR Managers and HODs can mark this. Confidential positions stay internal: no vendor push.

name: Workforce Plan-custom_monthly_budget_per_headcount
label: Monthly Budget Per Headcount (USD) $
description: Budget Per Headcount (USD) divided by 12. Calculated automatically.
